name: 06-09-root-catalog-aggregate-access-repository-projection
title: Root catalog aggregate access repository projection
creator: Latias94
notes: Completed repository-backed Public Catalog root aggregate access projection for /people, /tags, and /genres. Added CatalogRepository accessible root aggregate methods, SQLite/PostgreSQL access-before-pagination adapter implementations, DB catalog_access contract coverage, and HTTP route regressions. Verified with cargo fmt --all, cargo check -p nako-core -p nako-db -p nako-server --tests, cargo nextest run -p nako-db catalog_access --no-fail-fast, cargo nextest run -p nako-server catalog --no-fail-fast, and git diff --check. PostgreSQL ignored contract is compiled but not run locally without NAKO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL.
